title: BehaviorEvent
description: Schema for behavior events sent from the perception pipeline to the backend API.

event_id.description: Optional unique identifier for the event (e.g. UUID v4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp when the event occurred.

event_type.description: Type of monitored behavior or detected anomaly.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the perception model (0.0 to 1.0).

frame_number.description: Frame index from the video feed where the behavior was detected.

bounding_box.description: Bounding box coordinates [x, y, width, height].

metadata.description: Additional context object (e.g. camera_id, duration_seconds, notes).
